visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two Asian men are seated at a dark wooden table in a brightly lit indoor living room. The man on the left has long dark hair and wears a black ribbed long-sleeve shirt, pointing at a large smartphone he holds. The man on the right has short cropped hair and wears a gray textured fleece jacket, leaning in to look at the phone. Behind them is a vibrant yellow sofa and a blurred white shelf with decorative bottles and a green plant. (2) An overlay video appears in the top half of the frame showing a person's hand using a green plastic scraper to peel a car-themed sticker off a clear glass bowl. The background is white. (3) The overlay changes to show a blue and white box of liquid Band-Aids with Korean text and illustrations. (4) A macro close-up overlay shows a person's thumb with a small bloody cut on the side of the nail being pressed by a finger. (5) Transition back to the two men; an illustration of a tall stack of green cash bills appears over the man on the left as he gestures with his hands while talking. (6) A screen capture overlay shows a man in a helmet skateboarding on a road; graphic '+' icons and a helmet icon appear, which then gets checked off, simulating a shopping interface. (7) Back to the men; the man on the right is now holding the smartphone. A silver laptop with a visible Apple logo sits on the table in front of him. The man on the left continues to point at the screen and explain. (8) A grid of six YouTube Shorts thumbnails appears as an overlay, showing various Korean product reviews and household hacks from a channel named 'Coupang'. (9) The camera returns to the two men; the man on the left uses wide hand gestures to emphasize his points while the man on the right listens attentively. (10) A screen recording shows the 'Store' tab of a YouTube channel with products like Brita water filters and keyboards listed with prices in NTD. (11) Another screen recording shows a crowdfunding website named 'Zeczec' featuring products like heated clothing and humidifiers with funding progress bars. (12) The man on the left looks directly into the camera, smiles, and gives a thumbs-up gesture. A yellow graphic sparkle effect is edited over his left eye for emphasis.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a male speaker (Voice A) talking in a fast, clear, and enthusiastic tone about opening Korean YouTube channels. A mid-tempo, upbeat pop background track with a prominent acoustic guitar rhythm and electronic percussion plays continuously. (2) Voice A continues describing the profitability of these channels, his voice rising in pitch for emphasis. Subtle digital 'pop' sound effects occur simultaneously with graphic transitions on screen. (3) A second male speaker (Voice B) interjects with a brief, curious question, shifting the dialogue to a conversational back-and-forth. The BGM remains steady. (4) Voice A explains the 'YouTube Shopping' feature in Korea; his delivery is informative with high articulation clarity. The acoustic guitar in the BGM provides a bright, rhythmic foundation. (5) Voice B reacts with a short, surprised 'Wow' exclamation, exhibiting higher vocal arousal. (6) Voice A transitions to discussing the Taiwan market and his partnership with 'Zeczec'. His tone becomes more promotional and direct, maintaining a high speech rate. narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate viewers about the new 'YouTube Shopping' feature by using successful Korean 'Coupang' unboxing channels as a case study, ultimately promoting the creators' own integrated shop on the Zeczec platform. It blends informational commentary with a direct commercial endorsement.
